title: A Domatic Analogue of $χ$-Bounded Graph Classes and the Gyárfás-Sumner Conjecture
summary: Given a graph $G$, a dominating set is a subset $X\subseteq V(G)$ such that $N[X]=V(G)$. The \emph{domatic number} of $G$, denoted ${\rm dom}(G)$, is the maximum size of a partition of $V(G)$ into dominating sets. In analogy with the lower bound of the chromatic number by the clique number, the domatic number satisfies the upper bound ${\rm dom}(G)\le δ(G)+1$ where $δ(G)$ is the minimum degree of $G$.
